subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – changing your sender name
body_text:
Hi Neha,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us to find out where to change the sender name on your order emails.

What we completed during the call:
- Following our guidance, you changed the sender name to your brand name in Email settings, saved it, and confirmed it now shows your brand name.

What we went through:
- We explained that the sender name is changed under Email settings, then Sender name, by typing your brand name and saving.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-F5

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
